verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird has a stated venture capital practice advising high-growth companies, angels, incubators and accelerators. It also runs a TwoVenture guidance hub with a 'Start & Seed' section and offers a free German Term Sheet Generator for early financing rounds. Together these show a documented early-stage financing practice, but nothing in the evidence specifically addresses SAFEs, convertible notes or other convertible instruments. Missing for 10: explicit SAFE/convertible-instrument explainers or forms, documented pre-seed convertible deal experience, independent corroboration.
